messages:
Maya (Product): quick thread — alignment on tier gating for microbundle GA. Draft choices: Starter (50k tokens/day), Growth (250k/day), Pilot (custom). Also auto-burst rules. Need comments by EOD.
Sam (Sales): Starter is fine, but Growth ceiling needs justification for enterprise pilots — sales are seeing asks >300k/day.
Jun (Eng): Growth 250k/day ok if we put per-endpoint QPS limits and token-length caps. Otherwise it's memory heavy.
Ravi (Finance): tier price bands need to reflect burst risk. Recommend Growth pricing include a standby premium.
Lena (Legal): confirm T&Cs mention revocation and non-guarantee language for burst. Also want a default overage charge schedule.
Priya (Customer Success): add in-product education for tiers, clear upgrade flow, and a 14-day free trial for Starter.
Maya (Product): dev checklist: billing hooks, telemetry, UI copy, playbook. GA launch gate: <1% of orgs hit hard cap during canary, ops runbook validated.
ops-bot: Canary deploy scheduled 05:00 UTC.
Jun (Eng): ETA 3 sprints to fully instrument and enforce.
Maya (Product): decision: proceed with Starter + Growth public, Pilot custom for enterprise. We'll keep Growth at 250k/day and require prepay for >300k exceptions. Legal & Finance to confirm wording/pricing.
